_comment: Art that proves the INVENTORY PANEL is open, plus the region it covers.
WHY: the panel is opaque, so while it is open everything inside that region is UI, not
world. Items already in the bag draw a hover TOOLTIP - real text, read correctly by OCR -
and auto-collect went and clicked it. Measured on the owner's screenshot 4, which has both
at once: the ground label's centre is at (0.119, 0.445) of the frame and the inventory
tooltip's at (0.803, 0.567), so one rectangle separates them with room to spare.
THE TEMPLATE IS THE PANEL'S TITLE BAR - the word INVENTORY and the stone around it. That
is the one part of the panel that never holds an item, a socket or a tooltip, which is
Error_history.txt #44's rule: a reference may contain only pixels that CANNOT change.
Measured: 1.000 on all three open frames, 0.000-0.120 on in-game frames with it closed.
keep_out is [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the ANCHOR WINDOW, same as search_region, so it
survives the game being windowed, moved or resized. It runs from the panel's left frame
edge (measured at x=1223 of 1914, i.e. 0.639) to the right edge of the window, and down
to below the gold box. Nothing is lost by being generous: the panel is opaque, so a ground
item under it cannot be seen or clicked anyway.
source_size is the resolution the art was cut AT, not the template's own size.
name: inventory title
